intro.zh-Hans: 为应用设置关闭行为和 Dock 图标。设置自动保存。
intro.en: Choose how apps close and appear in the Dock. Changes save automatically.

self.dockFailed.zh-Hans: 未能调整 DockHush 的 Dock 图标，请重试。
self.dockFailed.en: Couldn’t change DockHush’s Dock icon. Please try again.

self.dockShown.zh-Hans: DockHush 已显示在 Dock 中。
self.dockShown.en: DockHush is now shown in the Dock.

self.dockHidden.zh-Hans: DockHush 已从 Dock 隐藏，可从菜单栏重新打开。
self.dockHidden.en: DockHush is hidden from the Dock. Reopen it from the menu bar.

zspace.restart.zh-Hans: 设置已保存，尚未接管极空间。请通过本面板打开并允许适配。
zspace.restart.en: Settings saved; ZSpace integration is not active. Open it from this panel and allow integration.

close.enabled.zh-Hans: 已为 {0} 开启关闭时隐藏。
close.enabled.en: Hide on Close is on for {0}.

close.disabled.zh-Hans: 已为 {0} 关闭关闭时隐藏。
close.disabled.en: Hide on Close is off for {0}.

close.permission.zh-Hans: 设置已保存。开启“辅助功能”权限后生效。
close.permission.en: Settings saved. Enable Accessibility to apply them.

self.dockHelp.zh-Hans: 开启显示，关闭隐藏。立即生效，自动保存。
self.dockHelp.en: On shows the icon; off hides it. Applies immediately and saves automatically.

dock.helpInstant.zh-Hans: 开启显示，关闭隐藏。与“关闭时隐藏”独立设置。
dock.helpInstant.en: On shows the icon; off hides it. Independent of Hide on Close.

dock.helpRestart.zh-Hans: 开启显示，关闭隐藏。部分应用需要重启，请先保存工作。原配置会先备份，失败自动恢复。
dock.helpRestart.en: On shows the icon; off hides it. Some apps need to restart, so save your work first. Settings are backed up and restored if the change fails.

dock.openToApply.zh-Hans: 通过本窗口打开后生效
dock.openToApply.en: Open from this window to apply

dock.native.zh-Hans: 应用默认不显示 Dock 图标
dock.native.en: Hidden by the app by default

app.hidden.zh-Hans: 已隐藏 {0} 的窗口，应用继续运行。
app.hidden.en: Windows hidden for {0}. The app is still running.

error.hideApp.zh-Hans: 未能隐藏 {0}。请确认应用正在运行，并检查“辅助功能”权限。
error.hideApp.en: Couldn’t hide {0}. Check that the app is running and Accessibility is enabled.

zspace.hidden.zh-Hans: 极空间窗口已隐藏，应用继续运行。
zspace.hidden.en: Windows hidden for 极空间. The app is still running.

zspace.ready.zh-Hans: 极空间已打开，关闭时隐藏已就绪。
zspace.ready.en: 极空间 is open. Hide on Close is ready.

zspace.failed.zh-Hans: 请退出极空间，再右键点击列表中的应用并选择“打开应用”。
zspace.failed.en: Quit 极空间, then right-click it in the list and choose Open App.

error.hideWindow.zh-Hans: 未能隐藏窗口。请检查应用状态和“辅助功能”权限。
error.hideWindow.en: Couldn’t hide the window. Check the app’s status and Accessibility permission.

tagline.zh-Hans: 应用继续运行，桌面少些打扰。
tagline.en: Keep apps running. Keep your desktop clear.

permission.readyHelp.zh-Hans: 点击红色关闭按钮隐藏应用；使用 ⌘Q 仍可退出。
permission.readyHelp.en: Use the red close button to hide an app. ⌘Q still quits it.

permission.help.zh-Hans: 开启“辅助功能”权限，以使用关闭时隐藏。
permission.help.en: Enable Accessibility to use Hide on Close.

filter.hideSystemHelp.zh-Hans: 仅从列表中隐藏 macOS 自带应用，不影响已有设置。
filter.hideSystemHelp.en: Hide built-in macOS apps from this list. Existing settings stay active.

self.closeHelp.zh-Hans: 关闭主窗口后，DockHush 会继续运行。
self.closeHelp.en: DockHush keeps running when you close its main window.

close.help.zh-Hans: 点击红色关闭按钮时隐藏应用，保持后台运行。使用 ⌘Q 仍可退出。
close.help.en: Hide the app when you click its red close button. ⌘Q still quits it.

footer.zh-Hans: 共 {0} 个应用 · 部分设置需要重启应用，原配置将先备份。
footer.en: {0} apps found · Some changes restart the app after backing up its settings.

menu.tooltip.zh-Hans: 隐坞 DockHush · 打开主窗口

error.protected.zh-Hans: 此应用受 macOS 保护，无法调整 Dock 图标。
error.protected.en: This app is protected by macOS. Its Dock icon can’t be changed.

error.symlink.zh-Hans: 此应用的配置文件是链接，未作修改。
error.symlink.en: This app’s settings file is a link. No changes were made.

error.noWrite.zh-Hans: 无法修改此应用。请检查“App 管理”权限和文件权限。
error.noWrite.en: Can’t modify this app. Check App Management and file permissions.

error.pending.zh-Hans: 此应用有未完成的恢复记录，请先查看备份。
error.pending.en: This app has an unfinished recovery. Review its backup first.

error.externalChange.zh-Hans: 应用文件已变化，操作已暂停，备份已保留。
error.externalChange.en: The app’s files changed. The operation was paused and the backup was kept.

error.launchTimeout.en: The app took too long to launch

error.unsupported.zh-Hans: 此应用暂不支持该 Dock 设置
error.unsupported.en: This app didn’t apply the Dock setting

error.busy.zh-Hans: 正在处理另一项设置，请稍后再试。
error.busy.en: Another change is in progress. Please try again shortly.

error.otherCopy.zh-Hans: 正在运行此应用的另一份副本，操作已暂停。
error.otherCopy.en: Another copy of this app is running. The operation was paused.

error.identity.zh-Hans: 无法确认应用信息，未作修改。
error.identity.en: Couldn’t verify the app’s identity. No changes were made.

error.updatedConfig.zh-Hans: 应用已更新或设置已变化。操作已暂停，未用旧备份覆盖。
error.updatedConfig.en: The app was updated or its settings changed. The operation was paused; the old backup wasn’t applied.

progress.quitting.zh-Hans: 已备份，正在退出应用…如有保存提示，请先保存。
progress.quitting.en: Settings backed up. Quitting the app… Please respond to any save prompts.

error.quitTimeout.zh-Hans: 应用尚未退出，已取消操作。请处理保存提示后重试。
error.quitTimeout.en: The app hasn’t quit, so the change was cancelled. Respond to any save prompts, then try again.

error.updatedStop.zh-Hans: 应用已更新，操作已暂停。
error.updatedStop.en: The app was updated. The operation was paused.

progress.verifying.zh-Hans: 正在重启应用并检查设置…失败将自动恢复。
progress.verifying.en: Restarting the app and checking the change… Settings will be restored if it fails.

progress.restoring.zh-Hans: 设置未生效，正在恢复原配置…
progress.restoring.en: The change didn’t take effect. Restoring the previous settings…

result.hidden.zh-Hans: 已隐藏 Dock 图标，应用继续运行。
result.hidden.en: Dock icon hidden. The app is still running.

result.shown.zh-Hans: 已显示 Dock 图标，应用继续运行。
result.shown.en: Dock icon shown. The app is still running.

error.pathChanged.zh-Hans: 应用位置已变化，恢复已暂停。
error.pathChanged.en: The app’s location changed. Recovery was paused.

error.restoreConflict.zh-Hans: 应用文件已变化，未覆盖新文件。请查看备份以恢复。
error.restoreConflict.en: The app’s files changed. They weren’t overwritten. Review the backup to recover.

error.restoreQuit.zh-Hans: 应用尚未退出，自动恢复已暂停。
error.restoreQuit.en: The app hasn’t quit. Automatic recovery was paused.

result.restoredOpened.zh-Hans: 已恢复原配置，并重新打开应用。
result.restoredOpened.en: Previous settings restored and the app reopened.

error.reopen.zh-Hans: 原配置已恢复，但未能重新打开应用：{0}
error.reopen.en: Previous settings restored, but the app couldn’t reopen: {0}

error.restore.zh-Hans: 未能自动恢复，请查看备份。详情：{0}
error.restore.en: Automatic recovery failed. Review the backup. Details: {0}

progress.recovering.zh-Hans: 正在恢复上次未完成的设置…

settings.languageHelp.zh-Hans: 语言切换立即生效，不会重启其他应用。
settings.languageHelp.en: Language changes apply immediately without restarting other apps.

settings.managementHelp.zh-Hans: 调整部分应用的 Dock 图标需要“App 管理”权限。
settings.managementHelp.en: Changing some apps’ Dock icons requires App Management permission.

zspace.nodeRequired.zh-Hans: 极空间适配需要 Node.js 22 或更新版本，请安装后重试。
zspace.nodeRequired.en: ZSpace integration requires Node.js 22 or later. Install it, then try again.

zspace.consentTitle.zh-Hans: 启用极空间后台运行适配？

zspace.consentBody.zh-Hans: 请先保存极空间中的工作。确认后，DockHush 会正常退出并重新启动极空间，使用仅限本机的临时调试端口安装关闭时隐藏和 Dock 控制逻辑，然后关闭端口。接管后开关会直接生效。端口开放期间，本机调试连接可以访问极空间进程内的数据。适配依赖极空间版本；失败时可能退出刚启动的极空间。
zspace.consentBody.en: Save your work in ZSpace first. After confirmation, DockHush quits and relaunches ZSpace, uses a temporary localhost debugger to install Hide on Close and Dock controls, then closes the debugger. Switches apply directly after integration. While open, local debugger connections can access ZSpace process data. Support depends on the ZSpace version; setup failure may terminate the newly launched ZSpace process.

zspace.quitFailed.zh-Hans: 极空间未正常退出，设置尚未生效。请保存工作并处理退出提示后重试。
zspace.quitFailed.en: ZSpace did not quit normally; settings are not active. Save your work, resolve any quit prompts, and retry.
